title: Exact solution for a periodically driven magnetic multilayer system
summary: Periodic driving serves as an effective method for controlling the properties of physical systems. Called "Floquet engineering," it is a broad field of theoretical and experimental activity. Whereas original Floquet theory was proposed to a system of ordinary differential equations, the quantum systems with time-dependent potential require using partial differential equations. Among different methods of analysis of such systems, time series is a most common one.
